product_one_liner.value: TrackTik is a cloud-based security-workforce platform for guarding companies and enterprise security teams that manages frontline operations and connects them to back-office workflows such as incident reporting, billing, and invoicing.
product_one_liner.notes: Trackforce describes its cloud platform as serving guarding companies and enterprise organizations; its TrackTik page says it connects frontline security operations to financial back-office workflows.

pricing_page.notes: Trackforce has a dedicated public pricing page that describes selecting operational modules and receiving follow-up from a specialist. A public pricing page qualifies even though the page does not display fixed prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Trackforce’s case-study materials identify Blackbird Security as a customer, and its Airbus case study says Trackforce was chosen as Airbus’s provider. | named_customers.0: The Trackforce case-study page names Blackbird Security as a customer. | named_customers.1: The Airbus case study states that Trackforce was selected as Airbus’s provider.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile lists Trackforce’s size as 201–500, matching the requested band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Trackforce’s profile and company address identify Southlake, Texas as its headquarters location; the requested city value is Southlake. | hq_country: Trackforce’s LinkedIn profile identifies its headquarters in Southlake, Texas, and gives its Southlake address as being in the US.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook states Trackforce was founded in 2000, and Trackforce’s LinkedIn profile also gives 2000 as its founded year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index describes articles about security operations, guard management, incident reporting, and compliance. The reviewed index and entries did not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built, so this is not an engineering or technical blog under the stated definition.

public_docs.notes: Trackforce exposes a developer documentation portal with multiple API articles and how-to materials, meeting the requirement for public documentation with several articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists two openings, an Enterprise Sales Director and a Major Accounts Account Manager. Neither title is an AI, ML, or data-science role under the stated criteria.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed AI-product and security materials discuss ReportPro AI and data handling but do not name the AI model or inference provider; the subprocessor page offers a list on request rather than naming one. The provider is therefore unknown from the cited public materials.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Trackforce’s trust and security materials name SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR. The list includes only the requested items named on those pages. | compliance_certs.0: The trust page explicitly names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The trust page explicitly names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The trust page explicitly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Tracxn identifies the latest listed round as Series B, dated September 3, 2019. Other secondary-source entries conflict, so this best-supported stage is given with medium confidence. | funding_date: Tracxn dates the latest listed Series B to September 3, 2019, and K1’s announcement is dated September 3, 2019. The requested YYYY-MM value is therefore 2019-09. Conflicting secondary entries lower confidence. | funding_amount_usd: Tracxn’s record gives the latest round as a $150 million Series B in September 2019, and its profile updated in 2026 also identifies that round as latest. K1’s contemporaneous announcement corroborates an investment of over $150 million. Secondary sources surfaced conflicting later entries, so the selected amount is the best-supported figure and confidence is medium.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent round supported by Tracxn’s current profile and structured record is from September 2019, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025. Secondary sources contain conflicting later claims, including a 2023 entry and an uncorroborated 2026 claim; because these are not corroborated by the current Tracxn record or primary announcement, the best-supported answer is false with medium confidence.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Trackforce has a live Account Executive posting, which matches the roles included by the hiring criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: The reviewed company news/launch index identifies ReportPro AI as the newest launch-type announcement found, dated September 25, 2025—before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026. No later product launch was identified in the reviewed history.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Trackforce announced Scott Kaine’s appointment as CEO on January 12, 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Trackforce systems-administrator job post names Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, ZoomInfo, DealHub, and HubSpot; it also names Workato for automation workflows. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job post names Salesforce as a GTM system. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job post names Outreach as a sales engagement system. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job post names Gong as a GTM tool. | crm_stack_signal.3: The job post names ZoomInfo as a prospecting/GTM tool. | crm_stack_signal.4: The job post names DealHub as a GTM tool. | crm_stack_signal.5: The job post names HubSpot as a marketing automation platform. | crm_stack_signal.6: The job post names Workato for API connections, data syncs, and automation workflows.
